mapper.sql: c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM service_category ancestor WHERE (ancestor.status <> 1 OR ancestor.is_deleted <> 0) AND c.path LIKE CONCAT(ancestor.path, '%') )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.path, c.level, c.name, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.status, c.is_deleted, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM service_category c WHERE ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.path, c.level, c.name, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.status, c.is_deleted, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM service_category c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND LIMIT 1
